messages:
Sophia Nguyen: hey everyone! i'm Sophia (she/her) — excited to join Redwood this week :wave: i'm in Toronto, into plants (my pothos has survived three moves :seedling:), board games, and punny commit messages. coffee: black. any sticker recs? also curious who to ping about badge/access. ttyl!

Miguel Torres: welcome Sophia! :wave: i'm miguel from eng-runtime. we do plant swaps on #plants — totally down for a cutting. sticker rec: 'keep calm and cache on' 😄

Harpreet Singh: hi Sophia, welcome! badge/access is via people-ops — ping @people-ops or DM them. onboarding buddy @Avery Li will reach out shortly.

Avery Li: hey @Sophia! i'll DM you your onboarding schedule and set up a quick intro tomorrow morning. also coffee run? :coffee: 

DevOpsBot: Badge request note: Sophia Nguyen added to pending approvals queue. Expect building access within 1 business day.

Priya Desai: welcome!! we have a casual board-game night Thu evenings — remote folks join via Tabletop Simulator. if you like strategy games, ping me :game_die: 

Nina Park: pothos pics pls :camera_flash: 

Sophia Nguyen: sharing one — https://imgur.com/a/placeholder (she's a messy vine, not an influencer) :laughing: 

Miguel Torres: cutting incoming! i'll bring a tiny jar when i'm next in the SF office.

Harpreet Singh: FYI the welcome kit includes a plant mister if you chose an office kit :seedling: 

Marketing: welcome to Redwood, Sophia! if you want swag (stickers, pins) DM marketing and we'll mail you a pack.

Sophia Nguyen: thanks everyone!! super excited to be here :heart: see you around :)
